name: Tunnelblick
description: Shows whether Tunnelblick is connected, connecting or disconnected. Click it to connect or disconnect each VPN, or open Tunnelblick's menu.
author: Seb-GRAF

quickConnect.title: Quick connect
quickConnect.description: One VPN's name, exactly as Tunnelblick shows it. It comes first in the popup, with its own Connect or Disconnect button. Settings can't list your VPNs, so type its name.
